stage1_extra_edges.effect: Each extra edge attached along two existing 0-cells creates one new generator in π1 (loop = path-arc * chord⁻¹) before 2-cells.

stage2_faces.effect: Each 2-cell kills the conjugacy class of its boundary word in π1.

M2_van_Kampen.conclusion: van Kampen counts match presentation shape (56 gens before relations if only extra edges are gens with path as tree). Does not alone decide π1=1.

M3_presentation_rewrite.caveat: Length-1 rewrite + free reduction is incomplete for general finitely presented groups; if it kills all gens, π1=1 is proved. If not, undecided.

remarks: Todd–Coxeter coset enumeration can prove finiteness of π1 if it terminates with 1 coset.
Not fully executed here (no GAP); length-1 rewrite is a special case of Tietze.
If π1 infinite perfect, covers are hard; H1=0 blocks abelian covers.
Decision problem for triviality of finitely presented groups is undecidable in general; this fixed finite presentation may still be decidable by specialized methods.

o4_clarification.detail: π1(K⁺)=1 proved by elementary collapses to a point (collapsible ⇒ contractible ⇒ simply connected). Category B continuum geometry only; does not promote residual stack.

poincare_implications.pc_statement_3d: Perelman (2003): every closed simply connected 3-manifold is homeomorphic to S^3.

implications_if_pi1_Kplus_trivial.if_Kplus_simply_connected_and_homology_p: K⁺ is a simply connected homology point 2-complex (already H_*=pt). That does not make K⁺ a 3-manifold.
implications_if_pi1_Kplus_trivial.if_CB4_smooth_closed_M_with_pi1_1_and_H_: A closed smooth 3-manifold with π1=1 is homeomorphic to S^3 (PC). With H_*=H_*(pt) automatic for S^3. Spin: S^3 admits unique spin structure.
implications_if_pi1_Kplus_trivial.if_CB4_is_ball_not_closed: A contractible compact 3-manifold with boundary is a ball (in PL/smooth category under standard 3d results); PC on the double yields S^3.

implications_if_pi1_Kplus_nontrivial_per.CB4_contractible_fill_still_exists_PL: Cone C(K⁺) remains contractible even if π1(K⁺)≠1; the spine would not be simply connected, so K⁺ cannot be a deformation retract of a ball unless π1=1.

what_PC_does_not_do: Does not assign residual Ω_n classes
Does not identify G4 with geometry of S^3

conditional_bridge_Cat_B_only.if_O4_yes_and_O5_ball_spine: Then M ≅ B^3 (PL/smooth), unique spin, K⁺ ≃ spine; still Cat B continuum model.
conditional_bridge_Cat_B_only.if_O4_yes_and_O5_closed_M: Then M ≅ S^3 by PC; spin unique; still Cat B, not residual foundation.
conditional_bridge_Cat_B_only.status: conditional remarks only — not theorems of the residual stack

explicit_non_claims: No residual Category A promotion from π1 result
PC does not alone prove CB4
Collapsibility stronger than π1=1 but still Cat B continuum geometry
